FinancialMgmtMatchingAlgorithm.name: Advanced Matching Algorithm
FinancialMgmtMatchingAlgorithm.description: The Advanced Matching Algorithm adds the possibility to match a bank statement line with a "payment" if the financial account transaction is not found; or with an "invoice payment plan line" if a payment is not found; or with an "order payment plan line" if an invoice payment plan lines is not found; and finally to generate a credit for a Business Partner in case there are no transaction to match found. "Advanced Matching Algorithm" also creates the corresponding financial accounts transactions while matching and finally it adds unmatching at any time.

FinancialMgmtPaymentExecutionProcess.name: Simple Execution Process
FinancialMgmtPaymentExecutionProcess.description: Simple execution process that sets the status of the selected payments to Payment Made / Payment Received

FinancialMgmtPaymentExecutionProcess.name: Print Check simple process
FinancialMgmtPaymentExecutionProcess.description: Simple process that prompts for a check number and sets it as the reference number of the payment.

FinancialMgmtPaymentExecutionProcess.name: Leave as Credit
FinancialMgmtPaymentExecutionProcess.description: Execution process that on negative payments. Sets the leaves the payment amount as credit while modifying the payment's amount to zero.

ADAlertRule.name: Alert Taxes: Inversión del Sujeto Pasivo
ADAlertRule.sql: SELECT t.C_Tax_ID AS referencekey_id, t.Name AS record_id, 0 AS ad_role_id, NULL AS ad_user_id, 'En la versión 1.2.24 del módulo de impuestos para España, este impuesto fue sustituido por dos impuestos que diferencian transacciones desde países de la Unión Europea o de fuera de la UE. En sus sistema se encuentran documentos contabilizados con este impuesto. Es muy importante que descontabilice esos documentos y que sustituya el impuesto de Inversión de Sujeto Pasivo por el nuevo que corresponda y vuelva a contabilizar el documento. Para saber los documentos que están afectados, vea las Referencias a ese impuesto desde la ventana de configuración del impuesto' AS description, 'Y' AS isActive, 0 AS ad_org_id, t.ad_client_id AS ad_client_id, now() AS created, 0 AS createdBy, now() AS updated, 0 AS updatedBy FROM C_Tax t JOIN AD_REF_DATA_LOADED tm ON (t.c_tax_id=tm.specific_id) JOIN FACT_ACCT f ON (f.c_tax_id=tm.specific_id) WHERE tm.generic_id in ('0526654C55DD439BBF9432E00100494E', '10FCE3C3A4A24C3BB2D2E0423658D52E', '18D8A018FDED40EC9AAC800B73A39925', '2DE7B2012FD143649C11333CB26BB32F', '3A09347CF4A14830953EC8EF7A380F87', '46CAB684FA0B45729B75E8093F2AB3DF', '9BD28CCE1393432FB4A5164260CC1BA4', '9EC77D1C2FCA4B4983EF726DFC8BD385', 'A3B447E7596F4CB3A4C2CAE57D5C25E1', 'A9E786694E6C41289AF29E89D728B453', 'ABA548810F4D42C9A421CA91058431F9', 'CCF5F4991F254403993B767166214DDB', 'F123F6214D244778A051122CC574E4B9', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB8A0011', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB8E0022', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB8F0023', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB900028', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB950032', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB98003C', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB98003E', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB9A0042', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB9A0043', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804AB9D004D', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804ABA9005D', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804ABA9005E', 'FF80818123B7FC160123B804ABAA005F')
